$comment: EventFaces colour tokens (teal + midnight). The single source for web (frontend/src/app/globals.css, checked by src/lib/theme-tokens.test.ts) and iOS (ios/scripts/gen-colors.py -> Assets.xcassets). Values for bg..highlight are the brand spec; surface-2 and the status colours are derived and contrast-checked (>= 4.5:1 for every text pair in both themes). highlight is decorative only: in light mode it is 2.1:1 on bg, so it must never be the only cue.
